heading: Assignment Request Form - purpose
text: ASSIGNMENT REQUEST FORM. The policyholder (Assignor) requests HDFC Life to register the assignment of the policy as per the following details. Contact details provided herein will be updated for all future communications.

heading: Details of the Assignor
text: Name of the Policyholder (Assignor), Proposal/Policy No., Insurance Account No., Email ID, Contact No. (Office, Residential, Mobile). Mobile number is preferable. Customers registered under National Do Not Call Register: this response will be treated as valid discharge.

heading: Details of the Assignee
text: Name of the Assignee, Date of Birth, Place of Birth, Gender (M/F), Email ID, Contact No. Residential Address / Registered Office Address and Communication Address. The Assignee is (tick one): Individual, Firm, Company, Others (specify). Relationship of the Assignee with the Assignor (e.g. Parent/Spouse/Child/Lender/Creditor/Guarantor).

heading: Reason for Assignment and proof
text: Reason for Assignment: the reason could be a financial consideration, or love and affection where the assignment is to an immediate family member. Proof of Assignment enclosed, e.g. loan sanction letter. Note: applicable for assignment to an individual (other than the immediate family member), firm, company and others.

heading: Conditions of Assignment
text: Is the Assignment subject to any condition: Yes / No. If No, the Assignment will be treated as Absolute. If Yes, specify the condition(s), e.g. the Assignor will not have the right to execute any policy alteration or processing without the written consent of the Assignee. Upon expiry of the condition period, the Assignment will automatically become null and void and all rights revert to the Assignor.

heading: Important notes (items 1-3)
text: 1. The assignment of a policy shall automatically cancel any nomination made in the policy except assignment in favour of HDFC Life Insurance Company. 2. This assignment shall not be effectual unless this Assignment Form is duly completed and delivered, accompanied by the original Policy bond to the company. If the Assignee is a major, submit the ID proof and address proof of the Assignee. 3. Where the assignment is in favour of an individual or financial institution apart from our channel partners, the Assignor must get the signature of the Authorised Signatory on the company seal, stamped on one corner of the Endorsement Sheet.

heading: Important notes (items 4-6)
text: 4. Appointee signature will be required in cases where the Assignee is a minor. 5. Policy servicing charges may be levied as applicable. Please refer to your Policy document for details. 6. Taxes will be deducted at source, if applicable, from the payments made under a life insurance policy in accordance with the Income-tax Act, 1961. Tax laws are subject to change from time to time.

heading: Endorsement on the Policy document
text: I, the Policyholder, in consideration of the stated reason for assignment, do hereby as beneficial owner assign in favour of the Assignee, who is related to me as stated, all my rights, title and interest in the Insurance Policy granted by HDFC Life assuring the Sum Assured thereby and all other monies, benefits and advantages to be received thereunder, absolutely or on the following condition. Signed by the Policyholder (Assignor) with date and place, and a Witness with name and address.

heading: Third party declaration
text: The person who has affixed his/her thumb impression or has signed in vernacular has not filled this application form. The declarant states the content has been explained to the person, the answers truthfully recorded, and the person signed or affixed the thumb impression in the declarant's presence.

heading: Proposal details
text: Customer Declaration - Application/Proposal Form. Application/Proposal Form Number, Name of Life Assured / Proposed Policyholder, Type of Plan, Premium Payable (INR), Frequency, Premium Paying Term, Sum Assured (INR).

heading: Declarations on accuracy and misstatement
text: The relevant true copies of originals have been submitted and nothing material is withheld. I/We understand that in case of misstatement and suppression of material facts the policy will be treated in accordance with Section 45 of the Insurance Act, 1938 as amended. I/We shall notify the Company in writing of any change in my health, occupation or income between the date of the Proposal Form and the date of acceptance of my proposal.

heading: Premium, acceptance and communication consent
text: The first premium has been deposited with the Proposal Form and further premiums will be paid strictly in accordance with the Policy. The Company has the right to accept or reject the proposal without giving reasons. I/We authorise the Company and its representatives to communicate through call, email, SMS or VoIP including WhatsApp regarding my insurance policy or financial planning and waive any registration under NCPR (National Customer Preference Registry) or any registry prescribed by TRAI.

heading: Medical information and data sharing consent
text: I/We consent to the Company seeking medical information from any doctor, hospital or past or present employer concerning anything affecting the physical or mental health of the person to be insured, and from any insurer to whom an application has been made, for underwriting and claim settlement. I/We authorise the Company to share information, including medical records, solely for underwriting or claims settlement and with any governmental or regulatory authority.

heading: Signatures and declarant details
text: Signature or thumb impression of the (primary) life to be assured; the signature should match the signature on the ECS/SI mandate. Declaration by the person who explained the contents in the language of the proposer, with name, address and occupation of the declarant and the witness. Date DD/MM/YYYY and place.
